title: The complexity of SEFE for two graphs
formal: Can one decide in polynomial time whether two planar graphs on the same vertex set have planar topological drawings that coincide on their shared vertices and edges?
context:
Common edges must have identical curves in both drawings; there is no restriction to straight edges. Results for three or more graphs do not settle the two-graph case.

This question was found through Wikipedia and compared individually with the existing candidate and archived records. The linked literature provides definitions and background; this import is not a completed research-card review.
why: A central simultaneous graph-drawing problem about making overlapping structures geometrically consistent.
